Step 1: 34 weeks + 7 days = 34 × 7 + 7 = 238 + 7 = 245 days.  
Step 2: 12-21-1980 + 245 days.  
1980 is a leap year (divisible by 4).  
From Dec 21, 1980:  
Dec 21 → Dec 31 = 10 days (remaining in Dec).  
245 − 10 = 235 days left.  
1981 is not a leap year.  
Jan 31 days, Feb 28 days, Mar 31 days, Apr 30 days, May 31 days, Jun 30 days, Jul 31 days, Aug 31 days.  
Sum: 31+28+31+30+31+30+31+31 = 243 days into 1981.  
235 days < 243, so date is in Aug 1981.  
Jan 31 (31), Feb 28 (59), Mar 31 (90), Apr 30 (120), May 31 (151), Jun 30 (181), Jul 31 (212).  
235 − 212 = 23 days into August → Aug 23, 1981.  

FINAL_ANSWER: 1981-08-23
